script_pretty.title: It Hurts to Be Pretty

about.bio: I'm a photographer and filmmaker based in New York City. This fall I'm starting an MFA in TV Writing at Stony Brook University, moving from images into scripted storytelling. I mostly interested in developing pilots, spec scripts, and short films.
about.pastLife: Before turning to visual storytelling full-time, I spent several years studying and working as a research engineer in aerospace and fluid dynamics, working at Airbus, Safran, research labs in France, Brazil, and the US.
about.equipment: Shooting on a Sony A7III with a Sony E PZ 18-105mm f/4 G OSS lens, stabilized with a DJI RS4 Mini.
